verdict.rationale: Docs show periodic user access reviews run across connected apps with data pulled in via native/custom integrations or CSV, designated reviewers per system with recurring schedules and reminders, in-app sign-off (confirm ownership, decide maintain/modify/revoke), and follow-up tasks generated within the workflow. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that completed review results/sign-offs are stored as an artifact in a dedicated 'evidence library' and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
